{{Quote|Glory to Kujet, ruler of all, may his reign be everlasting.|Peridea wall script|<ref name="Part Six">{{Ahsoka|Part Six: Far, Far Away}}</ref>}}
'''Kujet''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Zeffonian]] held up as one of the greatest, if infamous, of the culture's icons. A [[Zeffo Sage]] with ties to the [[extragalactic]] [[planet]] [[Peridea]] and [[the galaxy]]'s world of [[Dathomir]], the ancient figure was a ruthless [[Politics#Dictatorship|authoritarian]] shrouded in the [[dark side of the Force]].

==Biography==
At some point during his life, Kujet ruled over the [[extragalactic]] [[planet]] [[Peridea]]. A text on a wall chamber on Peridea that stated he was a ruler of all and that his reign be everlasting.<ref name="Part Six" />

Kujet was a Zeffo Sage who established a great [[Tomb of Kujet|palace]] on the planet [[Dathomir]] [[Standard century|centuries]] before the [[Proclamation of the New Order|fall]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Withdrawn in comparison to other great Sages of the Zeffo, Kujet's palace was secluded and difficult to reach during the height of the individual Zeffo's power. Reigning in the [[time]] after Sages [[Eilram]] and [[Miktrull]], Kujet was a ruthless leader who ordered the destruction of the [[astrium]]s the [[species]] used in their [[Religion|religious]] practices.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />

The followers of Kujet were promised power and control over the [[The Force|Life Wind]], yet the Sage proved to be treacherous and cruel. From the seat of power on Dathomir, Kujet staged a massacre in the halls of his palace, reducing resistance to ashen ruin. When Kujet [[Death|died]], he was [[Burial|entombed]] within a sarcophagus then placed upon the walls of the his great temple. Within Kujet's dead [[Limb|hands]] held one of the last remaining astriums.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|My friend, I have never been one to shy away from the pursuit of knowledge, but the shadow of the dark side lies heavy in this tomb. I've uncovered Kujet's legacy: a ruthless leader who destroyed the Astriums and lives of any who opposed the sage's rule. These Zeffo were once Kujet's enemies, brave rebels who stood against tyranny.|Eno Cordova|<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />}}
[[File:DathomirRuins.png|thumb|The Tomb of Kujet, the resting place of the Zeffo Sage who led his civilization into decline.]]
The [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] [[Force-sensitive|practitioner's]] reign marked the decline of Zeffo culture, and his resting place was left abandoned.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />
